name: Upper-bound sieve weight
statement: A finitely supported coefficient system lambda_d^+ producing a one-sided upper estimate after insertion into divisor sums.
pvg_translation: Weight on visible divisor profiles u <= nu^(D)(n)
claim_ceiling: A valid upper weight is not a prime-producing theorem.

name: Lower-bound sieve weight
statement: A finitely supported coefficient system lambda_d^- producing a one-sided lower estimate after insertion into divisor sums.
pvg_translation: Signed weight on visible divisor profiles u <= nu^(D)(n)
claim_ceiling: A lower weight outside its positivity regime yields no lower-bound certificate.

name: Fundamental lemma of sieve
statement: For suitable sieve dimension, level D, s=log D/log z, local densities, and controlled remainders, the sifted sum is approximated by a main product times upper/lower sieve functions with a quantified error.
pvg_translation: Approximation theorem after aggregating truncated divisibility profiles
claim_ceiling: Not derivable from PVG encoding alone.

name: Upper sieve function F_kappa(s)
statement: Dimension-dependent upper-bound function valid in its theorem-specific domain.
claim_ceiling: Do not compare values across incompatible normalizations.

name: Lower sieve function f_kappa(s)
statement: Dimension-dependent lower-bound function whose positivity begins only beyond a theorem-specific threshold.
claim_ceiling: f_kappa(s)<=0 gives no positive sifted-set conclusion.

name: Remainder family r_d
statement: A_d = X g(d) + r_d for squarefree or otherwise specified moduli d.
pvg_translation: Difference between aggregate divisor-channel mass and the declared local main-term model
claim_ceiling: The remainder has meaning only relative to a named sequence and main-term model.

name: Aggregate remainder norm
statement: A usable certificate specifies a bound such as sum_{d<D}|lambda_d r_d| or sum_{d<D}|r_d| with all ranges and weights explicit.
claim_ceiling: A pointwise remainder statement is not interchangeable with an aggregate norm.

name: Sieve ratio s
statement: s = log D / log z controls the relation between the distribution level and the sieving threshold.
pvg_translation: Ratio between visible divisor depth and excluded prime-axis scale
claim_ceiling: Large s alone does not certify a theorem.

name: Weighted divisor sum to PVG box sum
statement: sum_{d|n} lambda_d equals a finite sum of lambda(exp(u)) over valuation subvectors u<=nu(n) whose decoded divisor lies in support.
preserves: one-sided pointwise inequality if already proved

name: Weight existence does not imply fundamental lemma
statement: Constructing finite lambda_d^+/- does not establish the fundamental lemma without dimension, local-density, and remainder hypotheses.

name: Small finite remainder does not imply asymptotic remainder norm
statement: A bounded numerical sample cannot certify a uniform asymptotic remainder estimate.

name: Lower sieve bound does not imply primes
statement: A positive lower bound for a sifted set may count almost-primes or composites and is not automatically prime-producing.
